scope: Operator verification safety only; no maintenance execution

changes.optimization: Explicit SafetyError checks; optimization rejected before database configuration import
changes.coverage: Verbose JSON plans require the intended qualified index and a verified non-indexed reference
changes.identity: TCP and Docker cluster/database/OID/role equality; pinned context/endpoint/container/image/volume/ports
changes.inventory: Exact definitions, attributes, collations, opclasses, uniqueness, constraints, valid/ready/live flags
changes.recovery: Before/after logical OIDs and filenodes; phase gates; guarded SQL text generation only
changes.disk: Enforced minimum 1 GiB each on C:, D:, Docker data and /tmp

negative_cases: wrong index/schema/table and sorted indexed fallback
wrong cluster/database/OID/role through either or both paths
changed definition, attributes, collation, uniqueness and constraint links
unexpected migration revision or collation provider/locale/version
unchanged filenodes or changed logical OIDs after claimed rebuild
out-of-order or non-quiescent SQL plan generation
validation.live_baseline_recheck: verified; logical OIDs and filenodes unchanged
validation.live_final_phase_negative: rejected: Wrong recorded collation for phase
validation.live_quiescent_negative: rejected while API database sessions remain; no SQL plan file created
validation.powershell: Runbook block parsed successfully by Windows PowerShell 5.1.19041.7725; commands not executed

remaining_gates: Independent focused review of verifier, tests and runbook
Explicit authorization for backup and disposable restore/rehearsal
Successful fresh backup, rehearsal and quiescent gates before development writes
Separate deployment preflight and authorization for migration/bootstrap
